prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input: Image1 is the entire original Silent Storm opaque equipment diffuse atlas enlarged exactly8x nearest-neighbor solely to reveal source layout. It is the edit target.
Request: Faithful HD reconstruction; return the complete same wide2:1 flat opaque UV atlas only.
Source inventory: Wide2:1 plain muted warm gray-brown cloth cap atlas. Preserve ONE large round shaded cloth disk left, ONE smaller dark cloth ring with original black central cutout lower-right, exactly THREE narrow horizontal shaded strip fields upper-right, and narrow dark vertical field along far-right boundary. Every field and black cutout stays at exact source coordinate/count. Plain cloth, no new stitching, outline piping, rim hardware, labels or emblem. Soft original shaded edges must remain soft.
UV/content lock: Keep every original contour, island, black gap, color field, mark, seam, fold and baked shadow at EXACT normalized coordinates, identical shape/count/phase and detail scale. WHOLE canvas only, no bounding-box extraction/crop/padding/repacking. Preserve opaque black and dark regions, not transparent backgrounds. Soft original reflections stay soft, do not reinterpret them as geometric bevels or extra pieces.
Material: All cloth remains source plain cloth, fine very subtle irregular fiber texture only. Keep smooth low-contrast shading and dark/muted source palette. No curls/ornament, repeating hatch or coarse weave, wrinkles, stitching, scratches, damage, piping or added outlines. Coarse source pixel/compression blocks are not new seams. Later exposure is matched numerically; material and layout must already be faithful.
Avoid: Hardware, rivets, buttons, holes, straps, buckles, labels, letters, logos or new recognizable components except the exact original marks explicitly described in inventory. No item photograph, perspective, background scene or redesign. Exact source count/shape/phase, plain material and UV geometry have priority.
reference_recipe: Exact original entire canvas8x nearest sourceguide; no crop/padding/bbox/artistic edits. Raw entire-canvas normalized to logical4x Lanczos only, source alpha/numeric brightness handled by root.
